title: Terms of use

sections.title: About this site
body: This site presents Vitreva’s mobile windshield replacement service in Gatineau and lets you request a quote.

sections.title: Quotes and appointments
body: Submitting a request does not confirm a price or an appointment. The work, price, location and availability must be confirmed directly with Vitreva.

sections.title: Calibration and aftercare
body: ADAS calibration needs are referred to an appropriate provider. Aftercare instructions are provided for your particular installation.

sections.title: Photographs
body: Illustrative photographs show the service; they are not evidence of completed jobs.

sections.title: Contact
body: For any questions, contact Vitreva at contact@vitreva.ca.
